lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.unitTitle: Data: Scaled Graphs and Measurement Line Plots
lessonRef.focus: one- and two-step questions from a graph
lessonRef.title: Guided practice A: one- and two-step questions from a graph

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Use this example as the model for the guided set below.

items.prompt: A scaled bar graph uses a scale of 5 per symbol. A bar shows 3 symbols. What does that bar represent?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching adult. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: On a scaled bar graph with 1 per symbol, "Dogs" has 6 symbols and "Cats" has 2 symbols. How many more does "Dogs" have than "Cats"?
A survey collects 3 groups of 3 responses, then 12 more responses come in. How many responses in all?
A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 2 per symbol. The bar for "Bananas" is worth 3 symbols. How many does "Bananas" represent?
On a scaled bar graph with 2 per symbol, "Red" has 4 symbols and "Blue" has 3 symbols. How many more does "Red" have than "Blue"?
A survey collects 8 groups of 3 responses, then 8 more responses come in. How many responses in all?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 2 per symbol. The bar for "Blue" is worth 7 symbols. How many does "Blue" represent?
On a scaled bar graph with 2 per symbol, "Dogs" has 4 symbols and "Cats" has 1 symbols. How many more does "Dogs" have than "Cats"?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A survey collects 6 groups of 3 responses, then 8 responses are removed as duplicates. How many responses are left?
A scaled bar graph shows a survey where each bar length equals a count of 5 per symbol. The bar for "Birds" is worth 2 symbols. How many does "Birds" represent?
